notes: Va (Waarde) isn't mandatory per AFAS's own schema, but the template's rules require it — per policy the template wins, so mandatory is true here.

Four AFAS fields have no column and are left unmapped; none are required by AFAS or by the template, so nothing is blocked: EnSe (Dienstverband — which employment record this parameter applies to, relevant only if an employee has more than one; same ambiguity already flagged on hrm-verlofsaldo and hrm-uitzendkrachten), DiTp (Toepassing, enum T/V/H — how the value is spread across multiple dienstverbanden), ReAu (Reden — a blob-typed field, unusual for this connector, possibly a free-text or attachment reason), PcId (Plaatsing).

Cleanest mapping so far: all 5 sheet columns land on an AFAS field, required-ness lines up everywhere except Va above, and there are no object-choice judgment calls or missing structural fields the way there were for erp-projecten, hrm-medewerkers, hrm-uitzendkrachten, hrm-wagenpark and hrm-verlofsaldo.
